statement: xpad keeps presence state, input pointer, queued work and URBs in individual USB-interface contexts. A slot presence loss unregisters that interface's input/LED without directly tearing down sibling contexts; USB receiver unplug triggers disconnect cleanup of its bound interfaces, stopping workers, input and output. Shared-bus fault behavior is not demonstrated.
